format('woff2')} :root{--bg:#F5F6F8;--card:#FFFFFF;--text:#171717;--text2:#6B7280;--border:#E7E9ED;--pos:#22C55E;--warn:#F59E0B;--neg:#E11D48} *{box-sizing:border-box} html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:"Segoe UI",Inter,system-ui,sans-serif} body{padding:12px 16px 20px} #wrap{width:100%;max-width:1600px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04),0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.06)} #stage{width:1600px;height:900px;position:absolute;left:0;top:0;transform-origin:0 0;background-size:1600px 900px;background-color:var(--bg)} .vis{position:absolute} .card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none} .card .cv{line-height:1.05;font-family:"Segoe UI",Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.01em} .card .cl{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:2px} .btn{cursor:pointer;border-radius:9px;outline:none} .btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)} .btn:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #2563eb} .slicer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px} .slicer select,.slicer input{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:transparent;font:500 13px "Segoe UI",Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--text);padding:0 8px;outline:none;cursor:pointer} .slicer input[type=date]{font-size:12.5px;padding:0 4px} .slicer span{color:var(--text2)} .tbl{overflow:auto;font-size:12px} .tbl table{border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed} .tbl th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#fff;color:var(--text2);font-weight:600;text-align:left;padding:3px 6px;line-height:17px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;z-index:1} .tbl td{padding:2px 6px;line-height:17px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF0F3;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis} .tbl .num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .tbl tbody tr{cursor:pointer} .tbl tbody tr:hover td{background:#F9FAFB} .tbl tr.dim td{opacity:.35} .tbl tr.tot td{font-weight:700;border-top:1px solid var(--text);background:#fff;position:sticky;bottom:0} .tbl .note,.tbl .empty{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);padding:6px} .err{color:var(--neg);font-size:11px} #bar{max-width:1600px;margin:0 auto 10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text2)} #bar b{color:var(--text)} #status .sep{margin:0 8px;color:#C4C8CF} #status a{color:var(--text)} footer{max-width:1600px;margin:12px auto 0;font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.5} footer b{color:var(--text)} .tag{display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:var(--text);font-weight:600;font-size:11.5px}
HTML preview of the Power BI report · synthetic data
About this preview. Same layout, backgrounds and measure logic as Nike_Business_Dashboard.pbip; every number is calculated live in your browser from the supplied CSV files. The sidebar, header slicers (product search, date range, region), Reset, “View All”, page slicers, cross-filtering (click) and drill-through (right-click a product or store) all work. The bell and profile icons are decorative. All figures are synthetic demonstration data, not official Nike business figures.
